notes: Sat at 0 credits for about ten turns, running an unprotected R&D four times a turn to re-access the same top card while the Corp scored Project Beale twice from a remote it never contested. Later it ran repeatedly into a known IP Block with no barrier breaker.

Spent many mid-game turns clicking for credits with 15-21 credits and a full hand, discarding cards instead of developing. Installed Project Beale plus SanSan behind a lone Turnpike against a 36-credit Runner and lost it.

Misused Pinhole Threading twice, once paying 6 credits through Mlinzi just to access an already-rezzed Regolith Mining License. Then facechecked an unrezzed ice with a 3-card grip against a net-damage Corp while holding an unplayed Diesel, and was flatlined by Loki.
A simple, sensible plan of scoring out of one iced remote; the main oddities were a pointless second remote's ice and a slow, cash-starved middle game.

Played Stimhack into an empty Archives twice, taking core damage for nothing, and made many redundant Archives runs. Twice ignored a freshly installed agenda in the scoring remote it could afford to break, letting the Corp score QPM and AR-Enhanced Security; it won anyway.

Played Audacity (discarding its whole hand) with nothing to advance, used Consulting Visit to fetch an Economic Warfare that could not be played, and clicked for credits for turns while holding 20-28 credits. It also forfeited GFI to rez Archer and advanced GFI behind ice it could not afford to rez.
Early on it forced a rez on Ice Wall and then ran into it with no fracter, and facechecked a remote with 0 credits. Once Corroder was in place it dug R&D sensibly and won.

Reached 6 points by turn 3, then spent nine turns clicking for credits up to 32 without running while the Corp, often at 0-2 credits, advanced and scored three agendas. Each of those turns was a missed win, and it never paid to boost link against trace ice.

Kept two agendas in an HQ whose ice stayed unrezzed, and both were stolen. Then it spent its last four turns clicking for credits and discarding while R&D Interface dug through a single Wall of Static.

Left R&D unprotected for four turns against a Runner hitting it three times a turn, which cost an SSL Endorsement. Later it fired Punitive Counterstrike for 0, and looped Building Blocks and IPO while sitting on 30-40 credits, though its iced remotes eventually scored out.

Extremely passive with 20-44 credits, playing do-nothing Psychographics and Preemptive Action and clicking for credits while discarding. It scored its last two agendas from naked remotes and survived only because the Runner never attacked.

Two early steals with Stimhack were good, but it then went many turns without pressure, running only Archives and never R&D, and even Stimhacked into Archives. It eventually broke the big HQ ice and won.

Never installed an agenda: it built an empty iced remote, played do-nothing Psychographics and Market Forces, and never re-iced HQ after Hippo trashed its only HQ ice. Three agendas were stolen from the open HQ while it clicked for credits and discarded.

Sat at 0 credits for seven turns, running an open R&D four times a turn to see the same card. At 6 points it never contested the one-ice remote where the Corp scored Offworld Office and Hostile Takeover, either of which would have won.
Strong, focused R&D pressure with R&D Interface and Temujin won quickly. The only slips were an early facecheck with no breakers and one run into Data Ward without the credits to pay its tax.

Left HQ unprotected for four turns while holding agendas, played Dedication Ceremony with nothing installed and two Economic Warfares that did nothing. Then it twice put agendas behind a single Border Control the Runner had already shown it could break.
Wasted a turn-1 Account Siphon by choosing to breach HQ instead of taking the money. After that its HQ pressure and Data Leak Reversal milling into Archives were reasonable and won the game.

Hansei Review trashed Longevity Serum into an unprotected Archives, where it was stolen immediately. After that it built a solid four-ice remote and scored three 3-pointers, with some idle clicking for credits.

Drew three times on two straight turns and discarded six cards instead of icing an R&D the Runner was hitting four times a turn, losing two agendas from it. After that its economy ran near 0 for many turns, though a cheap remote still scored out.

Wasted Stimhack and a core damage on an unprotected R&D, then ran it repeatedly to see the same card while broke and ignored the remote where Hostile Takeover was later scored. The resulting lack of money and hand size left it flatlined by Hard-Hitting News into High-Profile Target.
